Phase 1 - Introduction & Methodology:
- MetodologiaStep: NURA Flow methodology explanation
- ObjetivosAdicionaisStep: Additional goals selection

Phase 2 - Biometric Data Collection:
- IdadeStep: Age selection with scroll interface
- GeneroStep: Gender selection
- AlturaEPesoStep: Height and weight input controls
- NivelAtividadeStep: Activity level (sedentary to very active)
- ConfirmacaoMetasStep: Goals confirmation summary

Phase 3 - Goals & Targets:
- ObjetivosPrincipaisStep: Primary goal (lose/maintain/gain weight)
- ResumoIMCStep: BMI calculation and category display
- PesoObjetivoStep: Target weight selection
- VelocidadeMetaStep: Goal velocity (slow/moderate/fast)

Phase 4 - Hydration & Nutrition:
- ConsumoAguaStep: Water consumption awareness
- ImpactoAguaStep: Water impact education with bento grid
- EducaHidratacaoStep: Hydration and metabolism education
- RefeicoesDiariasStep: Meals per day selection
- LocalRefeicoesStep: Where user eats (home/work/restaurant)
- TipoDietaStep: Diet type preference
- RestricoesAlimentaresStep: Dietary restrictions (multi-select)
- MudancaHabitosStep: Habits to change (multi-select)

Phase 5 - Intermittent Fasting:
- ConheceJejumStep: IF knowledge (yes/no)
- BeneficiosJejumStep: Fasting benefits (autophagy, fat burn, clarity)
- EducaJejumStep: IF education with circadian cycle
- JanelaAlimentarStep: Eating window visualization

Phase 6 - Biometric Summary & Projections:
- ResumoBiometricoStep: Full biometric profile with BMI gauge
- ProjecaoSucessoStep: Success projection with animated chart
- ProvaSucessoStep: Social proof (87% success rate)
- LembretesRotinaStep: Reminder schedule configuration

Phase 7 - Plan Creation & Reveal:
- CriandoPlanoStep: Loading screen with AI animation (4.5s)
- PlanoPersonalizadoStep: 90-day plan reveal (3 phases)
- ExperienciaCaloriasStep: Calorie tracking experience level

Phase 8 - Welcome & Completion:
- NuraFlowStep: Welcome to Flow screen
- HomeFeedStep: Final screen with feed preview

Technical improvements:
- All components updated to use dynamic currentStep/totalSteps props
- Consistent progress bar calculation: (currentStep / totalSteps) * 100
- Material Symbols icons throughout
- NURA design system colors (primary: #00464f, secondary: #006d36)
- Framer Motion animations for enhanced UX
- Responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS
